text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `enable_cache_batch_v2` to ON as a canary tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Scope: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Audience: 5% random users. Risks: p95 tail latency on short sequences, cache churn. Need infra/oncall/QA ack and a quick perf smoke before expansion.

alex: SGTM. Is the 5% per-route or global? :eyes:

simon: per-route via routing-rules, we'll scope it to those two endpoints only. No global traffic.

jen: Perf/validation checklist: run k6 for 30m against the canary and compare against baseline (p50/p95/p99 + error_rate). Check `kv_cache.evictions`, `kv_cache.hit_rate`, and `batcher.pending_items`. If p95 jumps >30% or error_rate >0.5% (5m window) -> rollback.

oncall: I'm oncall that morning — I'll add alerts and watch the channel. Rolling 5-min error_rate >0.5% OR p95 increase >30% = auto-alert and manual rollback trigger. Ping me 5m before flip.

infra: We'll apply a soft rate cap to the canary (2x expected baseline QPS per route) and short-circuit long queues to avoid head-of-line issues. Also enabling extra tracing for the first hour.

maria: I'll kick the toggle in Console and trigger the deploy-bot rollout. PR for config + telemetry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/842 — pinging reviewers @alex @simon @jen for fast review.

alex: Reviewing now, left one comment about adding a fallback to the smaller model variant when cache miss spikes. Otherwise looks good.

simon: Good catch — I can add fallback logic to the runtime route matcher in the same PR. Will update.

jen: Quick smoke example (curl) to validate behavior after flip:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}'
```
Watch for `x-rw-cache: HIT|MISS` header and `batch_size` in logs.

jen: Operational metrics to keep an eye on: `kv_cache.hit_rate`, `kv_cache.evictions`, `batcher.batch_size_avg`, `batcher.latency.p95`, and `request.errors.rate`.

deploy-bot: scheduling toggle: `enable_cache_batch_v2` -> 5% (routes: /v1/generate,/v1/chat) at 2026-11-15T09:00PT. Rollout window: 60m. Guardrails: p95_increase_pct=30, error_rate_pct=0.5.

maria: Starting canary now. Will post snapshots every 15m. :rocket: Marking this thread for updates.

metrics-bot: canary snapshot (5m): p50 -12%, p95 +9%, p99 +15%, error_rate 0.12% — kv_cache.hit_rate +22%. No alerts triggered. :thumbsup:

jen: Nice. Those are within our guardrails — keep the load generator running for +30m to catch slow drift.

oncall: No alerts so far. I added a temporary dashboard and set a 5m paging threshold. If anything spikes I’ll call rollback.

alex: Merged the PR after the small fallback change.

simon: Runtime update applied. Fallback to smaller model variant will kick in if `kv_cache.evictions > 1000/min` for the canary group.

maria: After 60m everything looks stable. Increasing audience to 25% at 11:00 PT. Will continue to monitor and then remove flag if all green. Updating runbook with steps and rollback playbook.

oncall: Watching. No alerts during expansion.

maria: Thanks all — excellent coordination. Closing thread once we hit 100% or rollback.
